title: REQ · Wall, wainscot, floor and window grids exist at declared sizes
summary: Room shell grids with night-sky window
description: Context: the room shell is one flat SVG. Desired behavior: grids for striped wallpaper (480x150), wood wainscot with trim (480x40), plank floor (480x80) and a window (64x56) with frame, crescent moon and night sky, drawn with outlines and ramp shading from indigo, plum, moon, wood and brass ramps. Expected result: four ArtSource entries at declared sizes, using only palette indices. Why: these form the room backdrop.
acceptance_criteria: Given the wall source, when measured, then it is 480x150 and has alternating wallpaper stripes using two plum or indigo ramp indices
Given the wainscot and floor sources, when measured, then they are 480x40 and 480x80 and use wood ramp indices
Given the window source, when measured, then it is 64x56 and contains both moon-ramp and brass-ramp indices
